| description = No breath weapon, no rampage, no enrage. Ran at 14%. Hit hard, often max-hitting twice for 310. 

Duo'd 4 Jan 2023, by 60 monk and 60 torp shaman. Kar Sapara took 50k dmg. Slows landed easily after tash-stick proc and Malo. Gave up on dots due to resists. Dropped reinforced dragonhide belt.

Soloable by 60 torp shaman. Expect to spend the better part of an hour.
